name: IconTetris
tagline: 使用已安装 App 的图标，在主屏幕上玩俄罗斯方块。
description: 图标俄罗斯方块让你直接在主屏幕上游玩经典俄罗斯方块，每个方块都由设备中已安装 App 的图标组成。
消行可以获得分数，等级提升后下落速度会逐渐增加；游戏结束后可再次游玩或恢复原主屏幕。
notice: 🎮 长按主屏幕底部的 Search 按钮或页面指示器开始；轻触旋转，左右滑动平移，下滑软降，双击硬降。
features: 使用已安装 App 图标组成俄罗斯方块
在主屏幕上直接开始全屏游戏
支持旋转、左右移动、软降与硬降
消行计分、等级提升与逐渐加速
游戏结束后可重开或恢复主屏幕
支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的图标俄罗斯方块，确认总开关已启用。
返回主屏幕，长按底部 Search 按钮或页面指示器开始游戏。
轻触旋转；左右滑动平移；下滑软降；双击硬降。
游戏结束后选择再次游玩或恢复主屏幕。

changes: 新增使用已安装 App 图标游玩的主屏幕俄罗斯方块。
新增旋转、移动、软降、硬降、消行计分与等级加速。
增强全屏透明游戏体验，并修复设置图标与方块初始显示问题。

en.name: IconTetris
en.tagline: Play Tetris on the Home Screen using icons from installed apps.
description: IconTetris brings the classic Tetris experience directly to the Home Screen, with every block built from icons of installed apps.
Clear lines to score points as the falling speed increases with each level, then play again or restore the original Home Screen when the game ends.
en.notice: 🎮 Long-press the Search button or page indicator at the bottom of the Home Screen to start. Tap to rotate, swipe left or right to move, swipe down for a soft drop, and double-tap for a hard drop.
features: Build Tetris pieces from installed app icons
Play full-screen directly on the Home Screen
Rotate, move left or right, soft drop, and hard drop
Line clearing, scoring, levels, and increasing speed
Play again or restore the Home Screen after a game
English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
usage: Open IconTetris in Settings after installation and make sure it is enabled.
Return to the Home Screen and long-press the Search button or page indicator to start.
Tap to rotate, swipe left or right to move, swipe down for a soft drop, and double-tap for a hard drop.
Choose Play Again or Restore Home Screen when the game ends.

changes: Added a Home Screen Tetris game using icons from installed apps.
Added rotation, movement, soft drop, hard drop, line scoring, and level-based speed increases.
Improved the transparent full-screen experience and fixed the Settings icon and initial block appearance.
